fixed_before: M9 SMTP/FTP match-rule authorship; acceptance owner chose and froze instances without disclosing their response bytes to the corpus owner.
origin: All response bytes are original PacketcraftR fixtures, not imported scanner data.
split_policy: Service-instance holdout. Training instances and bytes are declared in the shipped corpus provenance; no held-out instance is used to author or tune a match rule.
measurement_policy: Claim confidence measures faithful extraction of unauthenticated presented tokens, not software identity accuracy. Protocol confidence measures protocol evidence only. Misleading banners remain claims. Handshake failures and malformed replies are reported separately from eligible service coverage.
